title: Plan: Plus is off
note: The Plan screen says plainly: "Your first two letters are free. Plus lets you keep adding." (no price, no trial length and no count of what is left; Apple's own sheet shows those). Every letter kept stays readable, playable and exportable. Apple handles payment; no card details are seen. There is no Buy button and no "Redeem a code" row on web: both need StoreKit, which exists only in the iOS app. NEEDS A REAL IPHONE: See what Plus adds, Redeem a code, Manage subscription.
